responsibility: Declares the HIR visitor that performs symbol liveness marking for Rust dead-code analysis. It exposes the static Analysis entry point returning the live HirId set, the worklist-driven traversal API, specialized visit hooks for reference-bearing expressions and item bodies, and helper routines that resolve path segments and mark discovered items, defining the interface and stored state for the mark-live phase rather than the warning phase.
same_name_distinction: Declares the MarkLive analysis class, its public Analysis/go entry points, visitor overrides, and worklist/live-set state for dead-code liveness; unlike the .cc file, it does not contain the entry-point discovery or symbol-marking implementations.
